name: Security Review

skillFrontmatter.name: security-review
skillFrontmatter.description: Review code changes for security vulnerabilities. Use when the user asks for a security review or before merging sensitive changes.

bodyTemplate:
# Security Review

## Checklist

{{#if parameters.checkOwasp}}
- [ ] No SQL injection (parameterized queries only)
- [ ] No XSS (sanitize output, use CSP)
- [ ] Authentication and authorization properly enforced
- [ ] Input validation on all external data
{{/if}}
{{#if parameters.checkSecrets}}
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or credentials
- [ ] Environment variables used for sensitive config
{{/if}}
- [ ] Dependencies checked for known vulnerabilities

## Severity levels

- **Critical**: Exploitable vulnerability, block merge
- **High**: Likely vulnerability, fix before merge
- **Medium**: Defense-in-depth improvement
